outcome: Death during the index (first) ICU stay
status: Secondary manuscript endpoint; current article presents 28-day all-cause mortality as primary and index-ICU mortality as secondary
source: Current 01_endpoints daily caches, raw endpoint timestamps and fixed K=3 assignments; source files remain unchanged
death_rule: A valid admissions.deathtime at or after hospital admission, within [ICU intime, ICU outtime], including equality at outtime
live_discharge_rule: Valid exact death after ICU outtime, or no exact death and no recorded death date on/before the ICU exit date
unknown_rule: Without a valid exact death timestamp, a recorded death date on/before the ICU exit date leaves the ICU outcome uncertain. Retain as unknown in descriptive counts and exclude from time-to-event models; never recode as live discharge or censoring
followup: From the landmark to index-ICU death or live discharge, without a 28/90-day administrative limit; later readmissions and post-ICU deaths do not change the index-stay endpoint
static_risk_set: Existing 24 h survivor cohort, still in the index ICU strictly after admission+24 h; remove unknown ICU outcomes separately
trajectory_risk_set: Existing fixed K=3 Day 7 survivor/ICU-resident risk set, with positive ICU follow-up after admission+7 days; remove unknown ICU outcomes separately
predictor_preprocessing: Reuse saved MIMIC-IV log2 winsorisation and standardisation parameters without refitting
adjustment: age + sex + race/ethnicity + Day 1 OASIS, using the existing core-four outcome covariate contract; for index-ICU models only, Other and Unknown race categories are combined identically in both databases because the MIMIC-III Day 7 Other category has 19 patients and zero ICU deaths, causing monotone likelihood in the original six-level model
primary_estimator: Fine-Gray: survival::finegray data expansion and weighted coxph, Breslow ties and ICU-stay-clustered robust variance; report subdistribution hazard ratios (sHR)
sensitivity_estimator: Cause-specific Cox, censoring live ICU discharge; report cause-specific HR (csHR)
cif: Nonparametric competing-risk cumulative incidence, cmprsk::cuminc; Gray tests for class differences; death and live discharge curves sum to at most one
cif_time_axis: Days since ICU admission; estimates calculated from the relevant landmark
cif_intervals: Pointwise 95% complementary log-log intervals from Aalen variance; no multiplicity correction

cif_display.panels: ICU mortality only, MIMIC-IV and MIMIC-III
cif_display.gray_test: Recomputed using administrative censoring at admission Day 60; later events become censored for this figure only
cif_display.full_stay_models: Original complete-index-ICU Fine-Gray and cause-specific Cox results remain unchanged

subgroups: The existing seven binary subgroups in the Day 7 risk set; Fine-Gray class contrasts and joint class-by-subgroup Wald tests, normally two df. For MIMIC-III CRRT, Class 1 has no recorded exposure, so the estimable interaction compares Classes 2/3 with one df. Continuous age retained; omit sex only within sex strata; BH correction separately across seven tests per database. Stratum estimates require N>=100 and >=20 ICU deaths, all three classes, and no zero-event adjustment factor level
treatment_exploration: The existing six fixed-cutoff first-day treatment comparisons in the complete assigned 24 h survivor cohort, not the Day 7 prognostic cohort; Fine-Gray class-specific associations adjusted for OASIS without MV points, age, sex and race; nominal interaction P values
treatment_scope: Any recorded NEE; >0.3 versus 0<NEE<=0.3 microgram/kg/min among exposed; net balance >2000 mL; net balance >30 mL/kg with weight 20-300 kg; recorded invasive MV; recorded CRRT. No pooled tertiles or outcome-driven cutoffs
treatment_interpretation: Retrospective associations stratified by a class learned from subsequent first-week observations
class_treatment_outcome_table: Complete assigned cohort with the existing user-confirmed organ-support-first intensity hierarchy; retain unknown intensity and unknown ICU outcome; percentages use the full database assigned N
image_qa: Not performed, as requested; numerical, text, structure and export checks only
